title: Lukasu Properties Limited v African Banking Corporation Zambia Limited (SCZ/08/10/2023; Appeal No.5/2023) [2024] ZMSC 28 (15 August 2024)
case_name: Lukasu Properties Limited v African Banking Corporation Zambia Limited
outcome_detail: Appeal allowed. The writ of summons issued by the respondent against the appellant and other defendants was incurably defective because no letter of demand had been served on the appellant — a mandatory pre-condition under Order VI rules 1, 2 and 4 of the High Court (Amendment) Rules 2020. Registry acceptance of the writ did not cure the defect. The writ was accordingly set aside for incompetence. Costs to the appellant in the Supreme Court and the Court of Appeal, to be agreed and in default taxed.
